Hi all — adding a few operational notes so the call can focus on decisions, not logistics.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_checklist_v2.pdf (see summary below)

Quick evidence & vendor checklist (high level):
- Evidence transfer: we can either: (A) provide a finite S3 share with time-limited credentials, or (B) drop bundles to a shared Google Drive folder. For regulated customers we default to S3 with strict IAM.
- Logs and retention: we'll describe available audit log exports (API keys, token access logs) and retention windows.
- Network reachability for pen-test: PenVantage typically needs a small IP range and a single authenticated endpoint for discovery/scans. Marcus — can you paste the default CIDR we hand to vendors?

Marcus: default vendor CIDR is 35.192.0.0/14 and 34.72.0.0/14 (we'll confirm the exact subnets for this engagement).

See attached checklist for the docs we typically pass before the call (SOC 2 summary, encryption notes, DPA excerpts). I'll upload a minimalizing summary to Drive and link it after Olivia confirms a slot.
